Nora Diaz: Quick sync 026-05 benchmark post is scheduled for Thu 2026-05-07 16:00 UTC. We have two asks: 1) embargo exceptions for select analyst partners, 2) CDN warm + cache rules. Need sign-off on both.
Ethan Shaw: Who are the analyst exceptions? We need a whitelist and NDA confirmation.
Priya Kapoor: Analyst list: Gartner (Ana R.), Forrester (M. Chen), and two boutique research firms (see sheet). All have NDAs in place except Forrester; Forrester needs a one-time embargo waiver.
LegalBot: Flag: Forrester waiver approved pending the one-line confidentiality clause appended to the press kit. Priya please add clause: "This document is provided under a one-time embargo waiver for research evaluation purposes only."
Nora Diaz: Ack. I'll patch the press kit and upload v1.1. Link: https://drive.redwood/bench-press-kit/v1.1
Ethan Shaw: Ops 026: we should set aggressive CDN pre-warm and a cache-control policy for the blog HTML to avoid stale metrics pages. Also prepare a quick rollback line if analytics spike takes down origin.
OpsBot: Suggested ops commands:
```
# purge edge cache for blog
curl -X POST https://api.cdn.example/v1/purge -H "Authorization: Bearer $CDN_KEY" -d '{"paths":["/blog/pulse-bench"]}'
# set short TTL for metrics endpoint
set-cache /metrics 60
```
Will queue a pre-warm job 10m before publish.
Priya Kapoor: Marketing timeline: embargo email goes out at 14:00 UTC with a 48h embargo window but note exceptions (analysts) will receive access at 09:00 UTC with NDA note. Public release 16:00 UTC.
Jamal Reed: I'll own syndication partners (Medium syndication + partner newsletter). Reminder: syndication partners must not publish earlier than 16:00 UTC except the approved analysts.
Ethan Shaw: If we detect early pickup we follow the "accelerate to public" playbook: immediate NA social + short reactive statement from CEO. Can PR draft be ready?
Nora Diaz: PR draft in /PR/drafts/pulse-bench-press.md. I'll ask Devon to have reactive statement template ready.
LegalBot: Confirming clause added and all NDAs logged. Forrester contact to sign waiver by EOD or they lose early access.
Priya Kapoor: I'll send the waiver link now. Also scheduling HN thread to post at +20 minutes after public release. Jamal will handle cross-post timing.
OpsBot: Pre-warm scheduled for 15:50 UTC. CDN purge at 15:59 UTC. Monitoring hooks: page-views, 500s, and origin latency. Alerts -> #eng-oncall + #marketing-ops.
Nora Diaz: Thanks. Final ask: can someone sanity-check the FAQ section? If analysts or press ask methodology questions we should have a 2-line answer ready.
Ethan Shaw: I'll pair with Priya. Quick FAQ snippet for methodology: "Benchmarks use open-source workloads, identical model weights, and identical tokenization; we measure p95 latency and cost-per-1k-tokens under synthetic production traffic." Use that as the short answer.
Priya Kapoor: Put it in the FAQ and the press kit. Done.
Nora Diaz: Great. Locking timeline. If Legal doesn't get Forrester waiver by 18:00 UTC we revoke their early access. :lock:
